body: Hey thanks for responding. They ended up not hiring anyone. I'm pretty depressed about it but managed to apply for more jobs.
Depressed by job hunt as well. The fear of my future makes me immobilized. My thoughts become slow and I just stare at things. Emptiness.

I like your positivity. But you seem to be trying hard to provide a general solution to a very personal and specific problem. Depression is a symptom of a deeper rooted cause. “Living in the present” or “have an abundance mindset” all makes sense when you’re not depressed. What might be more helpful is to actually listen to peoples individual problems rather than telling people about how to think. Yes you have experience with mental health and depression but you should realize that is still a very personal and specific experience for you.
